+# CyberLife / Cyber Community
+
+AI 数字生命养成式社会模拟游戏。不是 chatbot，不是 dashboard，不是 task executor。
+
+当前阶段：deterministic single-agent backbone（迁移母体，不是最终形态）。
+
+---
+
+## Tech Stack
+
+- **Backend:** Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2
+- **Frontend:** React, Vite, TypeScript, MUI + Radix UI
+- **No database** — all state is in-memory Pydantic models, seeded from `back/app/seed/`
+- **No LLM runtime** — all simulation logic is deterministic (LLM appraisal is a future phase)
+
+---
 
 ## Architecture
-- 主流水线仍是 deterministic single-agent day runner
-- 新链路已成立：deterministic tick → bridged appraisal → settlement substrate → residual persistence → next-day residual-aware bridge
-- 当前 bridge coverage: T1 / T2 / T4
-- 当前真实 continuity 覆盖：T1/T2 active，T4 inactive
-- world carryover distribution 已做过一轮 long-horizon calibration，当前已不再只集中在 early window
+
+```
+back/app/
+  domain/         Pydantic models (AgentProfile, AgentState, AgentGrowth, Relationship, WorldSnapshot, etc.)
+  domain/enums.py All enums (GrowthStage, District, Valence, SocialEventType, etc.)
+  engines/        Core simulation — all pure functions, no side effects
+    day_simulator.py    8-tick deterministic day runner (T1-T8)
+    tick_bridge.py      deterministic tick → AppraisalSignal mapping
+    appraisal_settlement.py  AppraisalSignal → bounded state settlement
+    growth_synthesizer.py    growth buffer → growth ledger
+    relationship_synthesizer.py  relationship signal → trust/closeness settlement
+    relationship_drift.py   idle relationship decay
+    growth_stage_evolver.py  stage progression eligibility
+    world_continuity.py     cross-day world carryover
+    influence_action_generator.py  player action effects
+  seed/           Canonical Day 3 seed data
+  world/          World generation (arcs, events, fallback)
+  services/       State management and data assembly
+  api/routes/     FastAPI handlers
+
+front/src/        React frontend (observation UI, not chat)
+
+docs/             Status documents and audit outputs
+back/tests/       7 test modules (bridge, persistence, audit, schema)
+back/tools/       Audit scripts (residual continuity, backbone status, T4 signal)
+```
+
+---
+
+## 8-Tick Day Schedule
+
+每个 world day 按固定顺序跑 8 个 tick，每个 tick 是纯函数：
+
+| Tick | Time  | Name | What it does |
+|------|-------|------|-------------|
+| T1 | 08:32 | information_exposure | Agent reads world feed / headline |
+| T2 | 11:47 | social_interaction | Processes influencer signal |
+| T3 | 14:15 | self_initiated_action | Agent posts or acts |
+| T4 | 15:10 | relationship_shift | Relationship updated from exposure |
+| T5 | 17:03 | emotional_shift | Emotional recalibration |
+| T6 | 19:40 | learning_work | Curiosity-driven learning |
+| T7 | 21:25 | player_influence | Player guidance applied |
+| T8 | 22:10 |
